description: Attach a counterparty's signed confirmation of an action already recorded in this session (e.g. a vendor confirming a corrected invoice total). The SDK derives the content binding from the attested action, so the confirmation cannot be pointed at content the counterparty never saw. If no counterpartyPrivateKeyPem is given, an ephemeral key is minted (present_unverified); supply an enrolled key plus identityProofRef for a vouched (present_verified) attestation.

attestedActionId.description: The actionId (from sequesign_record_action) the counterparty is confirming.

counterpartyId.description: Canonical counterparty id (lowercase alphanumeric segments joined by single dots or hyphens, e.g. 'vendor-abc').

counterpartyPrivateKeyPem.description: Ed25519 private-key PEM of the counterparty. Omit to mint an ephemeral key.

identityProofRef.description: base64url SignedRegistrationRecord (issuer 'sequesign') from enrollment, to make the attestation vouched (present_verified).

name: sequesign_record_counterparty_attestation
title: Record a counterparty attestation
